zimi_games: ZimiGames: over 100 offline games and 38 of Simon Tatham's puzzles, with learn-more links into your library.
Games feel like one app: the same New game sheet, controls and touch sizes everywhere, an accessible grid on every board, and games in Zimi's search.
Polished games: Canasta, Janggi, Mahjong, Loopy, Five Letters, Mancala and the solitaires play by the right rules and read better on a phone.

zimi_games: ZimCity: a city builder made for the phone, with the classic scenarios, an AI data center, solar and wind, a toy climate and citizens with opinions.
Daily games and leaderboards: today's edition of 63 games, the same for everyone on a Zimi server, with streaks, a spoiler-free share line and a board for the people on your server.
